content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways Abroad Internships abroad PROMOS funding for internships PROMOS funding for internships Through the student mobility scheme PROMOS, the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) seeks to fund a range of activities including subject-specific work experience in an extra-European context. The restricted resources of this programme means that applications for funding from the PROMOS internship programme should be made early. Please come by the International Office during the opening hours and get more information about the programme. Table of contents Who is eligible for funding? What is funded? Financial support The application procedure Notice Who is eligible for funding? All HTW students who have not previously received PROMOS funding. What is funded? This programme is intended to fund internships Conducted in Asia, Africa or Latin America With direct subject-specific relevance to the applicant's degree course With a minimum duration of two months within a calendar year Conducted in a public or a private company Depending on the budget internships in North America, New Zealand or Australia may be also funded. Internships for the winter semester have to start at the latest October 1st to be funded through the PROMOS programme. Financial support The students can get a funding between 900 and 1.100 euros depending on the country of destination. Please note: PROMOS funding is not provided for a traineeship conducted in an international organization, German embassies or any German diplomatic representation. For this kind of internships does exist special DAAD funding programmes. The application procedure Please come first to International Office and get all information about the programme. Places on the PROMOS programme are awarded on a first-come first-served basis. The link for registration/application you will find in the box on the right hand side. Please inform us about a need of special funding. So we can apply for it. Notice Please note that there does not exist any legal claim of getting the PROMOS funding.
